name: Starbrew Cafe: Mystical Merge
storyline: Aubrey is missing, Reese is behind bars, and Blake and Priscilla are brewing a world-changing scheme. Can Starla free Reese and find Aubrey, or will Blake and Priscilla make vampires cool again?
summary: Welcome to Starbrew Cafe, a charming oasis nestled in the heart of a bustling city. Join Starla on a journey where food and magic come together in a heartwarming tale. In this relaxing merge game you serve customers, repair the cafe, and meet new mysterious friends.
